items.title: The road surface on green lane leading from Little Witcombe Court Park to to Ermin way is very badly damaged with deep crevices of no tarmac left and right handsides of the road, with areas of no tarmac on the road itself regularly also flooding due to this and vehicle tyres are bring undually worn / damaged because of this. Not safe as a surace and is only wide enough for one vehicle as it is. in addition, when there were recent roadworks here earlier this year, they have leftsignage and rubbleall over the road, please can this road surface be re-laid.

items.title: The junction where vehicles turn left or right from GreenLane into Ermin Way is a blind junction, so thee is no visibility at all without half of your vehicle pulling out onto the road, which is a 40mph road, we need a traffic mirror opposite green lane so that vehicle drivers pulling out of the lane can see and vehicle drivers driving on Ermin Way can see there is a vehicle at this junction, as this is an extremely dangerous junction, it is a deathtrap.
